description: Governed MCP server for DMTF Redfish BMCs. Read-only by default; writes are opt-in and dry-run.
name: ai.mirastacklabs/mirastack-redfish-mcp

environmentVariables.description: JSON payload or YAML/JSON path defining one or more Redfish endpoints.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_ENDPOINTS

environmentVariables.description: Default endpoint name used when no endpoint argument is provided.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Single-endpoint Redfish base URL, for example https://192.0.2.10.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the single-endpoint Redfish password.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_PASSWORD_FILE

environmentVariables.description: TLS verification. Defaults to true. Set false only for lab endpoints with controlled certificates.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_VERIFY_SSL

environmentVariables.description: Path to a custom CA bundle used for TLS verification.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_CA_BUNDLE

environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for Redfish requests.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_TIMEOUT_SEC

environmentVariables.description: Auth mode: auto, session, or basic.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Write tier: off (default), power, config, or full. Mutating tools are not registered unless raised.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_WRITE_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Tool profile: core, standard, or full.
environmentVariables.name: MIRASTACK_REDFISH_TOOL_PROFILE

title: MIRASTACK Redfish MCP Server
